method.scale: badness = clamp(0,100, 50 + 15*z) where z is the standardised distance from the 2000–2019 average, signed so worse is higher
notes: Every value is the latest non-null observation available from the official source at build time; 'period' records which month/quarter/half-year/year it refers to.

HICP (inflation, food inflation, energy) uses Eurostat prc_hicp_minr (ECOICOP ver.2), which replaced prc_hicp_manr/prc_hicp_aind from 2026; legacy prc_hicp_aind is used for the 2000-2019 country baseline.

Country index: each component is scored against a POOLED 2000-2019 baseline - the mean and standard deviation of all 31 countries' annual values (sample winsorised at the 5th/95th percentile so that early-2000s hyperinflation in a few accession states does not swamp the scale). Components: inflation = latest HICP annual rate vs prc_hicp_aind annual averages; unemployment = latest monthly rate vs une_rt_a; growth = latest quarterly real GDP y/y vs nama_10_gdp annual growth; energy = latest household electricity price (EUR/kWh, band DC) vs all semi-annual nrg_pc_204 prices 2007-2019; debt = latest debt % GDP vs gov_10dd_edpt1 annual debt; purchasing_power = AIC per capita in PPS (EU27=100) vs prc_ppp_ind 2000-2019 (lower is worse).

Pooled baselines: inflation mean 2.32, sd 1.80 (n=614); unemployment mean 8.70, sd 3.94 (n=339); growth mean 2.58, sd 2.66 (n=599); energy mean 0.17, sd 0.05 (n=746); debt mean 57.11, sd 30.43 (n=540); purchasing_power mean 95.67, sd 27.19 (n=620).

EU index and history: EU27_2020 scored against its OWN 2000-2019 annual average. inflation = annual mean of monthly HICP annual rates (prc_hicp_minr); unemployment = annual mean of monthly SA rate (une_rt_m); growth = real GDP growth (nama_10_gdp CLV_PCH_PRE); energy = relative energy price, HICP energy index divided by all-items HICP (both 2015=100, x100; prc_hicp_minr); debt = gross debt % GDP (gov_10dd_edpt1); purchasing_power = growth of real adjusted gross disposable income of households per capita (nasa_10_ki B7G_R_HAB_GR, lower is worse). The current EU score uses the latest monthly/quarterly readings of the same concepts (latest quarterly debt from gov_10q_ggdebt).
EU baselines: inflation mean 1.93, sd 1.04; unemployment mean 9.34, sd 1.31; growth mean 1.56, sd 1.78; energy mean 94.55, sd 10.51; debt mean 74.77, sd 8.87; purchasing_power mean 1.14, sd 1.04.
'prev' index = the same calculation using each component's previous observation.

Gas is null where there is no household gas grid or no recent Eurostat coverage (Cyprus, Malta, Norway, Iceland, Switzerland, Finland); Poland's latest Eurostat household gas price is 2023-S2. Industrial production is not published monthly for Iceland. EU inflation for 2000 is unavailable in EU27_2020 HICP series, so the 2000 index uses five components.
deficit for IS: fallback Eurostat source gov_10a_main {'unit': 'PC_GDP', 'sector': 'S13', 'na_item': 'B9'}.
deficit for NO: fallback Eurostat source gov_10a_main {'unit': 'PC_GDP', 'sector': 'S13', 'na_item': 'B9'}.
deficit for CH: fallback Eurostat source gov_10a_main {'unit': 'PC_GDP', 'sector': 'S13', 'na_item': 'B9'}.

United Kingdom (no longer in Eurostat after 2020): ONS time series - CPI annual rate D7G7 (inflation), D7G8 (food), LFS unemployment rate MGSX and 16-24 rate MGWY (3-month average ending in the stated month), GDP q-on-q4 growth IHYR, Maastricht gross debt % GDP YEQJ, general government net lending/borrowing % GDP CT8O (annual), index of production B-E (K222, y/y computed; includes water supply, unlike Eurostat B-D).
housing for GB: OECD analytical house price database, nominal HPI (s.a.), % change vs same quarter a year earlier (not in Eurostat prc_hpi_q).
housing for GR: OECD analytical house price database, nominal HPI (s.a.), % change vs same quarter a year earlier (not in Eurostat prc_hpi_q).
debt for CH: IMF World Economic Outlook general government gross debt % GDP (annual, latest year <= 2025; broader than the Maastricht definition). Not in Eurostat.
debt for IS: IMF World Economic Outlook general government gross debt % GDP (annual, latest year <= 2025; broader than the Maastricht definition). Not in Eurostat.

electricity for GB: hand-entered from official source (https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/your-energy-supply/your-energy-bill/energy-price-cap-unit-rates-and-standing-charges). Ofgem default tariff cap, GB average, direct debit: mean of Jul-Sep 2026 (26.11p/kWh + 57.19p/day) and Oct-Dec 2026 (26.32p/kWh + 54.83p/day), standing charge spread over 2,700 kWh/yr (Ofgem typical consumption, inside Eurostat band DC). Converted at 0.84282 GBP/EUR (2026-10 ECB average).

gas for GB: hand-entered from official source (https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/your-energy-supply/your-energy-bill/energy-price-cap-unit-rates-and-standing-charges). Ofgem default tariff cap, GB average, direct debit, incl. 5% VAT: mean of Jul-Sep 2026 (7.33p/kWh + 29.04p/day) and Oct-Dec 2026 (7.97p/kWh + 29.68p/day), standing charge spread over 11,500 kWh/yr (inside Eurostat band D2). Converted at 0.84282 GBP/EUR (2026-10 ECB average).

electricity for CH: hand-entered from official source (https://www.elcom.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/znXqHISH0pFP/Newsletter_09-2025_D.pdf). ElCom (Swiss Federal Electricity Commission) median regulated tariff for a typical household (profile H4, 4,500 kWh/yr) for calendar year 2026: 27.7 Rp./kWh; 2025: 29.0 Rp./kWh (prev/y1, converted at the same current rate). Swiss tariffs are set per calendar year. Converted at 0.9282 CHF/EUR (2026-10 ECB average).

measures.label: Inflation
measures.desc: Harmonised consumer price inflation (HICP, all items), % change vs same month a year earlier.

measures.label: Food inflation
measures.desc: HICP food and non-alcoholic beverages, % change vs same month a year earlier.

measures.label: Unemployment
measures.desc: Unemployment rate, % of labour force, seasonally adjusted (ILO definition).

measures.label: Youth unemployment
measures.desc: Unemployment rate of people under 25, % of labour force, seasonally adjusted.

measures.label: GDP growth
measures.desc: Real GDP, % change vs same quarter a year earlier (chain-linked volumes).

measures.label: Government debt
measures.desc: General government consolidated gross debt (Maastricht), % of GDP.

measures.label: Budget balance
measures.desc: General government net lending (+) / net borrowing (-), % of GDP. Negative = deficit.

measures.label: Electricity price
measures.desc: Household electricity price incl. all taxes and levies, band DC (2,500-4,999 kWh/yr), €/kWh.

measures.label: Gas price
measures.desc: Household natural gas price incl. all taxes and levies, band D2 (20-199 GJ/yr), €/kWh.

measures.label: House prices
measures.desc: House price index, all dwellings, % change vs same quarter a year earlier.

measures.label: Purchasing power
measures.desc: Actual individual consumption per capita in purchasing power standards, EU27=100.

measures.label: Industrial production
measures.desc: Industrial production (mining, manufacturing, energy), % change vs same month a year earlier.
